facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Sportskeeda (2025-09-28) said players choose between two maps at start: Shutoko Expressway (main, more features) and Boneville Salt Flats (newer, buggier). Maps cannot be changed after a match has started.

facts.subject: gameplay

facts.subject: gameplay

facts.subject: gameplay
facts.claim: Sportskeeda warned that switching day/night can crash the session and that night mode was poorly developed. That report is from September 2025 and may not match the current Suspension-tagged build.

first_10_minutes: Open Midnight Chasers: Highway Racing at place 13822562292 (universe 4793836769). Ignore the live [💨SUSPENSION!] prefix when naming the game.
Join the Midnight In-dev group (id 16528477) so the advertised 25% cash boost can apply.
Pick a map if the start screen still offers a choice. Sportskeeda (2025) named Shutoko Expressway for cash/cruise and Boneville Salt Flats for racing; a later official post also named a Tokyo map.
Open Store (yellow left HUD under Spawn, or the tickets control some guides show bottom-left), go to Codes, redeem ThanksFor940k exactly as printed on the official description.
Do not paste extra spaces. Codes are reported as case-sensitive.
Spawn a vehicle from the dealership / spawn flow and start driving. Official goal is swerving through traffic or taking a regular drive.
Earn cash by driving and close traffic work; spend it at the dealership by spawn.
Optional paid start: VIP is 200 Robux for the advertised 50% cash boost, VIP tag, and extra build slots. Not required.
Skip Track Pass (175) and Police Pass (125) until you understand they do not gift the cars.
Mobile players who cannot open customization should know Mobile Customization is a separate 75 Robux pass.
If you want a concrete first goal besides cash, win one race for the Win a Race badge or simply explore with friends.
Watch the official description for the next like-milestone code (960000 at this check).
core_loop: Drive on highways and cities: cut up through traffic (no-hesi) or cruise.
Earn Cash / Money from driving, races, playtime rewards, and occasional codes.
Spend Cash at the spawn dealership on cars and motorcycles.
Customize at the shop beside the dealership (paint, nitro, tires, suspension, and other slots).
Race other players, explore with friends, and host or join meetups to show vehicles.
Join the group for the advertised 25% cash boost.
Optional VIP for the advertised 50% cash boost and extra build slots.
Redeem the current description code whenever the like milestone moves.
Repair / showcase loops exist in secondary writeups as between-race cash sinks and earners.
Maps are chosen at session start and, per Sportskeeda, cannot be swapped mid-match.
progression_path: Session 1: group join, redeem ThanksFor940k, learn traffic without immediately buying passes.
Use starter / cheap dealership cars until cash income feels consistent.
Put cash into a vehicle you actually enjoy driving; official copy does not name a required first buy.
Add customization (suspension is currently advertised in the live title) before chasing every dealership row.
Work toward 1,000,000 Money for the Richie badge if you want a mid-game marker.
Try a race for Win a Race; racing is optional, not the only loop.
Consider VIP (200 Robux) only after the free 25% group boost is already on.
Consider Track Pass or Police Pass only if you want those catalogs; you still pay in-game cash for the vehicles.
Watch @MidnightIndev, the group, Discord, and the Roblox description for the 960k-like code and the dated Future Update event card.
Do not plan around offsale Starter Pack or Premium Nitrous unless they return to sale.
Treat Sportskeeda's 155-vehicle count and 2025 top-speed names as historical snapshots.
Keep trademark-safe language: stylized names, no claimed real-world licenses.
common_mistakes: Skipping the Midnight In-dev group and missing the advertised 25% cash boost.
Typing codes with the wrong case or pasting extra spaces.
Using expired milestone codes copied from old articles (ThanksFor900k and friends).
Treating Pocket Tactics / Beebom / Bloxodes lists as official when they disagree with the game description.
Buying Track Pass or Police Pass expecting free cars. Official disclaimers say you still pay cash.
Stating a diamonds currency. Official systems are Cash/Money plus Robux passes.
Calling unofficial Fandom the official wiki, or confusing it with midnight-chasers.wiki.
Confusing this game with Midnight Racing: Tokyo.
Inventing a starter-car name or 'best first buy' price.
Claiming group + VIP definitely stack to a specific combined percent. Official pages do not say.
Hard-coding the [💨SUSPENSION!] prefix or the Aug 29 event card as evergreen.
Copying real-world car trademarks as if the game is licensed.
faq: What is Midnight Chasers? A Roblox no-hesi / highway cut-up driving experience by Midnight In-dev.
How do I redeem codes? Store / tickets > Codes > enter code > Redeem.
What is the current official code? The game description listed ThanksFor940k at this check; next listed target is 960000 likes.
How do I earn Cash besides codes? Drive through traffic, races, and playtime rewards. Group join and VIP are advertised cash boosts.
What does the group give? Official page: 25% cash boost.
What does VIP cost and give? Official catalog: 200 Robux; 50% cash boost, VIP tag, extra customization build slots.
Do Track Pass or Police Pass give free cars? No. Official disclaimers require in-game cash purchases.
Is there a 1,000,000 money badge? Yes, Richie.
Is racing required? No, but Win a Race exists. Official copy also invites regular drives and meetups.
How many maps? At least Shutoko, Boneville (Sportskeeda 2025), and Tokyo (official 2025 post). Confirm on the start screen.
Is there a Discord? Guides cite https://discord.com/invite/bQWFVXVqRj. Official X: @MidnightIndev.
Who is the Roblox creator? The Midnight In-dev group, not a single person.
Are vehicle names licensed? Official description says other trademarks belong to their owners and use does not imply affiliation.
